title: SynRM Torque Estimator
text: 估计机电转矩和功率，输入 6 路、输出 2 路；按 {Motor parameter input method} 指定电机参数的类型 Linear model with lumped；{Motor topology} 指定同步磁阻电机拓扑 Synchronous reluctance、{Definition of d-axis and q-axis} 指定 d 轴和 q 轴的对齐 Ld > Lq、{Number of pole pairs} 指定电机中可用的极对数、{D-axis current breakpoint vector, id (A)} 指定 d 轴电流查找向量、{Q-axis current breakpoint vector, iq (A)} 指定 Q 轴电流查找向量、{Stator d-axis inductance, Ld (H)} 指定 D 轴定子绕组电感 0.9e-3、{Stator q-axis inductance, Lq (H)} 指定 Q 轴定子绕组电感 0.15e-3、{Permanent magnet flux linkage, FluxPM (Wb)} 指定永磁体磁链 0.4e-4、{D-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxD(id,iq) (Wb)} 指定 D 轴磁链查找表数据、{Q-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxQ(id,iq) (Wb)} 指定 Q 轴磁链查找表数据、{Ld LUT, Ld(id,iq) (H)} 指定 D 轴电感查找表数据 0.9e-3 * ones、{Lq LUT, Lq(id,iq) (H)} 指定 q 轴电感查找表数据 0.15e-3 * ones、{PM flux linkage LUT, FluxPM(id,iq) (Wb)} 指定 PM 磁链查找表数据 0.4e-4 * ones、{Input units} 指定输入值的单位 Per-Unit、{Base Voltage (V)} 指定额定电压限值 24/sqrt、{Base Current (A)} 指定额定电流限值、{Base Speed (rpm)} 指定额定转速限值、{Base torque (Nm)} 指定额定转矩限值、{Base power (W)} 指定额定功率限值、{Allow scaled-down motor parameters with CodeGen (higher precision with Fixed-Point data type)} 按比例缩小内部参数以匹配标幺比例，按实例取值。

params.name: Motor topology
params.values: 同步磁阻电机拓扑 Synchronous reluctance motor (default) | PM-assisted synchronous reluctance motor

params.name: Definition of d-axis and q-axis
params.values: d 轴和 q 轴的对齐 Ld > Lq (different from PMSM) (default) | Lq > Ld (same as PMSM)

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: 电机中可用的极对数 4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Motor parameter input method
params.values: 电机参数的类型 Linear model with lumped parameters (default) | Non-linear model with D,Q-flux linkage LUTs | Non-linear model with Ld and Lq LUTs | Non-linear model with Ld, Lq, and FluxPM LUTs | Input port based Ld and Lq | Input port based Ld, Lq, and FluxPM

params.name: D-axis current breakpoint vector, id (A)
params.values: d 轴电流查找向量 [0,10,20,30] (default) | vector

params.name: Q-axis current breakpoint vector, iq (A)
params.values: Q 轴电流查找向量 [0,10,20,30,40] (default) | vector

params.name: Stator d-axis inductance, Ld (H)
params.values: D 轴定子绕组电感 0.9e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Stator q-axis inductance, Lq (H)
params.values: Q 轴定子绕组电感 0.15e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Permanent magnet flux linkage, FluxPM (Wb)
params.values: 永磁体磁链 0.4e-4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Ld LUT, Ld(id,iq) (H)
params.values: D 轴电感查找表数据 0.9e-3 * ones(4, 5) (default) | matrix

params.name: Lq LUT, Lq(id,iq) (H)
params.values: q 轴电感查找表数据 0.15e-3 * ones(4, 5) (default) | matrix

params.name: PM flux linkage LUT, FluxPM(id,iq) (Wb)
params.values: PM 磁链查找表数据 0.4e-4 * ones(4, 5) (default) | matrix

params.name: Input units
params.values: 输入值的单位 Per-Unit (PU) (default) | SI Units

params.name: Base Voltage (V)
params.values: 额定电压限值 24/sqrt(3) (default) | scalar

params.name: Base Current (A)
params.values: 额定电流限值 19.3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base Speed (rpm)
params.values: 额定转速限值 4107 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base torque (Nm)
params.values: 额定转矩限值 0.93271 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base power (W)
params.values: 额定功率限值 401.143 (default) | scalar

params.name: Allow scaled-down motor parameters with CodeGen (higher precision with Fixed-Point data type)
params.values: 按比例缩小内部参数以匹配标幺比例 on (default) | off
